a.title: Electricity and magnetism, drawn by Kosika
a.summary: A 6 volt battery drives current through a 4 ohm resistor, and a bar magnet's field runs from N to S.

beats.text: The battery pushes charge out of its positive plate and round the loop.
Ohm's law sets the current: 6 volts across 4 ohms gives 1.5 amps.
A magnet's field leaves its north pole and curves round into its south pole.
Each line keeps to the dipole law, closer together where the field is stronger.
